newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Amalgamated sees box office increase.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Amalgamated sees box office increase.

text.p: Entertainment, leisure and hotels group Amalgamated Holdings Ltd said on Thursday that box office revenues should increase in the second half of the year ending June 30.
The company said new screens were due to be added to its circuit and releases included "Evita", "Jerry Maguire", "Lost World" and "Batman and Robin".
A 10-screen multiplex cinema would open in Dubai later this calendar year, and other overseas opportunities were being explored.
Amalgamated said its cinema expansion in Australia would continue with new complexes to be opened on the Gold Coast, Melbourne, Adelaide and north Queensland.
The representation of Rydges Hotels and Resorts throughout Australia and New Zealand was largely complete, and future development would focus on the Middle East and South East Asia.

The newly formed Tourism and Leisure division would continue to pursue opportunites related to the completion of the Thredbo Alpine Training Centre, and the acquisition of Matilda Cruises and the Featherdale Wildlife Park in Sydney.
